# Documentation platform history

This independent four-part history starts with the adoption of platform
versions. Earlier documentation changes have no retroactive platform version.

## 0.1.0.0 - 2026-10-18

Summary: Document prioritized case review, the optional MCP summary, the updated
private dashboard, and the observed checks and remaining compatibility limits.

Threat impact: Explain that review tasks require analyst verification and that
aggregate MCP output excludes evidence text, identifiers and private paths.

Sovereignty impact: Retain local workflows and distinguish local helper checks
from client/model trials and external transmission decisions.

Validation: Source and packaged documentation links were checked. Browser
evidence covers screenshots only; interactive behavior remains unverified.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.
